vo_splice_map.opening_question_punctuated: What Will the Night Sky Look Like When Gliese 710 Arrives?
vo_splice_map.transcript: What will the night sky look like when Gliese 710 arrives? Right now, Gliese 710 in the constellation of Serpens, the serpent, is far too faint for your eyes on even the darkest night. You would need binoculars just to find it. Imagine the night of the closest pass. It is the brightest star, three times brighter than Sirius, and it glows orange.
